name: Barbell Overhead Press
steps: Stand with feet hip width and hold the bar at the front of your shoulders.
Grip just wider than shoulders with elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Brace your stomach and press the bar straight up over your head.
Lower the bar with control back to your shoulders.
cues: Move your head back, bar travels straight
Breathe in, brace, breathe out at top

common_mistakes.mistake: Leaning back to push the bar up
common_mistakes.fix: Squeeze glutes and stomach; lower the weight

common_mistakes.mistake: Pressing the bar out in front
common_mistakes.fix: Keep the bar close to your face on the way up

common_mistakes.mistake: Flaring the elbows wide at the start
common_mistakes.fix: Start with elbows slightly forward of the bar
